args.command:
python3 -c "
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, ROUND_HALF_DOWN, ROUND_CEILING, ROUND_FLOOR
d = Decimal('-1.005')
print('raw:', repr(d))
print('HALF_UP:', d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
print('HALF_DOWN:', d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_DOWN))
print('CEILING:', d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_CEILING))
print('FLOOR:', d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR))
print()
d2 = Decimal('1.005')
print('1.005 HALF_UP:', d2.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
print('1.005 HALF_DOWN:', d2.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_DOWN))
"
